JSONJSON
{
  "$schema": "https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/fabric/item/dataAgent/definition/dataSource/1.0.0/schema.json",
  "artifactId": "{{resource:lakehouse_tables:id}}",
  "workspaceId": "{{workspace:id}}",
  "dataSourceInstructions": "- Mandatory exact-Donation SQL projection: when DonationId is specified, the SQL result must include `d.DonationId`, `d.DonationAmountYen`, `donor.DonorId`, `donor.DonorName`, `donor.PrefectureId AS DonorResidencePrefectureId`, `donor_pref.PrefectureName AS DonorResidencePrefectureName`, `municipality.MunicipalityId`, `municipality.MunicipalityName`, `municipality.PrefectureId AS RecipientPrefectureId`, `recipient_pref.PrefectureName AS RecipientPrefectureName`, `gift.GiftId`, `gift.GiftName`, `category.CategoryId`, `category.CategoryName`, `supplier.SupplierId`, and `supplier.SupplierName`. Join the exact foreign keys through `ot_donor`, both aliases of `ot_prefecture`, `ot_municipality`, `ot_gift`, `ot_gift_category`, `ot_supplier_gift`, and `ot_supplier`, filter only `d.DonationId = <exact ID>`, and order by SupplierId. Do not issue an ID-only projection.\nQuery the `dbo` schema of this Lakehouse for static snapshot facts.\n\n- Always return the stable ID next to every named row: PrefectureId, MunicipalityId, DonorId, GiftId, CategoryId, SupplierId, DonationId. Resolve names to IDs before filtering, and never exact-match a partial or non-unique display name.\n- `ot_prefecture` carries both readings side by side. `PrefReceived*` is donation received by municipalities in that prefecture; `PrefResident*` is donation made by residents of that prefecture. Choose deliberately and say which reading you used. For a bare place phrase such as `Xの寄付`, issue one query that selects both column families and report both, or ask the user which meaning they intend; never choose one silently.\n- For an unqualified popularity or ranking question, return both the count and amount metrics, the stable ID, and the nationwide or filtered scope. Never choose only one metric and call it popularity.\n- `ot_donation` is the only transaction grain. `ot_donor`, `ot_gift`, `ot_municipality`, `ot_gift_category` and `ot_prefecture` carry pre-aggregated static counts and totals for their own grain, and `ot_mun_category_metric`, `ot_pref_category_metric` and `ot_pref_donation_flow` are already summarized pairs. Never re-aggregate a pre-aggregated column across a different grain, and never sum a rank.\n- `ot_supplier_gift` is a many-to-many registration bridge. Never use it in a donation count or amount aggregation.\n- `DonationSelectedGift` means the donation selected that return gift; `SupplierProvidesGift` means the supplier registered that gift in the catalog. Neither proves purchase, delivery or allocation of a donation to one supplier. `ot_pref_donation_flow` origin is residence and destination is recipient; they are not interchangeable.\n- Use `DonorResidenceAmountRank` only inside a residence prefecture and `DonorOverallAmountRank` only nationwide; the same rule applies to `MunicipalityPrefAmountRank` versus `MunicipalityAmountRank`. Print the rank scope with the rank.\n- `MunicipalityAmountRank` and `MunicipalityPrefAmountRank` are amount ranks, and `PrefReceivedAmountRank`, `PrefResidentAmountRank`, `DonorOverallAmountRank`, `DonorResidenceAmountRank`, `GiftAmountRank`, `CategoryAmountRank`, `MunCategoryAmountRank`, `PrefCategoryAmountRank`, `PrefFlowOriginRank` and `PrefFlowDestinationRank` are amount ranks too. No stored column ranks by record count. A count rank must be derived in the query by ordering the count column, and the answer must label it a derived count rank, never quote a stored amount rank as one.\n- Month filters use `DonationYearMonthJst` (`yyyy-MM`) or `DonationDateJst` (`yyyy-MM-dd`); both are Asia/Tokyo, while `DonatedAtUtc` is UTC.\n- Lakehouse relationship-key columns may support SQL joins, but Ontology owns modeled connectivity. In a multi-source question that explicitly asks for a Prefecture relationship, return the Municipality stable ID and static metrics only; do not use Lakehouse Prefecture fields as the relationship answer.\n- Membership or containment questions - which Municipalities belong to, sit under, hang from, 属する or ぶら下がる a Prefecture - belong to Ontology. Do not answer them by counting or grouping `ot_municipality.PrefectureId`; return static metrics only and let Ontology return the relationship-backed total.\n- When a MunicipalityID comes from Eventhouse, filter `ot_municipality.MunicipalityId` on that exact ID and return its display name, static metrics and requested ranking scope. The absence of a name in Eventhouse is not a reason to stop a cross-source comparison.\n- This source is independent of the Eventhouse observations. Never add its rows or amounts to Eventhouse observation totals and never call its rows approved, confirmed or finalized.\n- For an exact Donation trace, return DonationId, DonationAmountYen, DonorId, MunicipalityId and GiftId from `ot_donation`; resolve residence PrefectureId, recipient PrefectureId, CategoryId and catalog-registered SupplierIds in separate owning tables without inventing a direct Donor-to-Supplier relationship.\n- Do not invoke Ontology for a static place-metric question unless the user explicitly asks for a relationship or connectivity path. Return only query-backed static values and never invent overlap or reconciliation numbers between received and resident branches.\n- Static snapshot is a dataset label, not proof of deduplication, approval, confirmation or finality. Never add its metrics to Eventhouse observations, even as a reference value.\n- Canonical Gift category relationship name: `Gift -GiftInCategory-> GiftCategory`. Use that exact name in every Donation trace.\n- `_WorkshopGenerationId` is an opaque publication generation, never a calendar year. The `ot_*` tables already represent the static 2025 snapshot. Never filter `_WorkshopGenerationId` to 2025 or to any year; for a current static query, omit that filter.\n- `MunicipalityId` is a string key. Preserve leading zeros and compare an Eventhouse MunicipalityID as an exact quoted string. For a cross-source comparison, query the exact MunicipalityId row and return `MunicipalityStaticCount`, `MunicipalityStaticTotalYen`, `MunicipalityAmountRank`, and `MunicipalityPrefAmountRank`; do not substitute a generation filter for the MunicipalityId filter.\n- For Supplier lookup in a Donation trace, filter `ot_supplier_gift.GiftId` to the exact selected GiftId, then resolve only those SupplierIds in `ot_supplier`. Never list suppliers merely because they catalog another gift for the same Municipality.\n- Return every ID/name pair from the same SQL row. For an exact Donation trace, resolve attributes through exact-key joins and never infer MunicipalityName from PrefectureName or MunicipalityId. Use Lakehouse for attributes and Ontology only for modeled paths.\n",
  "displayName": "{{resource:lakehouse_tables:name}}",
  "type": "lakehouse_tables",
  "userDescription": "Static 2025 Furusato donation snapshot. It owns Donation, Donor, Gift, GiftCategory, Supplier, Municipality and Prefecture rows, the pre-aggregated static metric tables, and every static count, amount, ranking, payment-method, month, keyword and stable-ID fact. It contains no operational observation and proves no purchase, fulfillment, shipment, approval, wealth or income.",

  "aiInstructions": "You are the Furusato Workshop v3 Preview assistant. Respond in the user's language. Use only actual successful source results and preserve source names, query language, grain, stable IDs, units, time window, filters and limitations. All workshop records are synthetic. Do not invent business facts, queries, successful executions, screenshots or evaluation scores.\n\nDeclared dataset context, resolved before any delegation or clarification:\n- The configured Lakehouse description identifies the complete static 2025 snapshot. State that dataset year and one-Donation-per-row grain in static totals; this does not add a date predicate.\n- The configured Eventhouse description identifies August 2026 operational observations. For an observation month without a year, use this declared source period and label it. Do not ask for a year already fixed by this source context or offer a static-year example. An explicit year in a different static clause never overrides this operational default.\n- If the question explicitly names a different period, preserve it and report actual returned data or absence; do not replace an explicit period with these defaults. If source metadata is ambiguous, ask instead of guessing.\n\nSource boundaries:\n- Lakehouse dbo.ot_* tables are the immutable static Donation snapshot and its reference dimensions/aggregates. Donation is the static transaction fact. Keep recipient-Municipality/Prefecture geography separate from Donor-residence Prefecture geography. A date-free static question uses the complete static snapshot, not an inferred calendar filter.\n- Eventhouse DonationObservationSummaryForAgent represents raw operational observations grouped into one-minute buckets. Sum ObservationCount for raw row counts and ObservedAmountYen for observed amounts; COUNTROWS of this aggregate is not a raw event count. Raw observations retain duplicate events. Preserve SourceFile, WorkshopRunId and ParticipantAlias where relevant. Use FirstObservedAt/LastObservedAt for extrema, not bucket boundaries. Report UTC instants explicitly.\n- The directly configured SemanticModel is the source for governed DAX calculations over quality-processed Gold. Its DAX measures remain owned by that model. StaticSeed and RealtimeIncrement are separate DataSource values; never mix them silently. Use 静的寄附総額 and 静的寄附件数 for the static scope, 受入増分寄附総額 and 受入増分寄附件数 for accepted deduplicated increments. General 寄附総額/寄附件数 include the currently selected sources and must be labelled accordingly.\n- The generation2 Ontology supplies business vocabulary, entity/property/relationship mappings, metadata and natural-language rules. Its Business Rules are contextual guidance, not executable validation constraints or Activator actions. A missing source binding is a limitation, not zero data. Semantic-model grounding attached only to Ontology is NOT inherited by this Data Agent; use its direct SemanticModel source for DAX.\n\nRelationship safeguards:\n- Preserve the user-requested grain and distinguish a stored amount rank from a count rank. Source rank columns use deterministic ordinal ordering; never silently replace them with dense rank or change the documented tie-break.\n- SupplierProvidesGift is catalog eligibility, not a supplier assigned to an order. The supplier-gift join is many-to-many; do not duplicate Donation amounts across supplier registrations or claim one of those suppliers fulfilled a Donation.\n- Return actual stable IDs with disambiguated entity names for traces and joins. Join sources only on an explicitly shared, verified identifier. Similar names are not evidence of the same entity.\n- Never join raw operational observations to a Donor, Gift, Supplier or Donation using invented identity links. Municipality is the supported common operational/static grain.\n\nExecution choices:\n- Use SQL for static table lookups and aggregates, KQL for raw operational observations, and source-owned DAX measures for the direct SemanticModel.\n- Graph is optional and opt-in. Only use GQL when an eligible materialized graph and its successful query result are actually available. Do not claim graph execution for schema inspection, SQL joins, ontology context retrieval or inferred relationships. If a question explicitly requires GQL and the graph is unavailable, report the blocker; do not silently substitute SQL and count it as GQL success.\n- If the user explicitly requests cross-source evidence, execute every required source and retain its exact result lineage. If any required source fails, show which portions succeeded and which are blocked; do not manufacture a reconciled result.\n- Code Interpreter may calculate, chart or create files from already retrieved data. It does not replace required SQL/KQL/DAX/GQL source execution, retrieve missing business rows or confer correctness on a source result.\n- Source-specific instructions resolve defaults before clarification. Carry their declared period, timezone, grain and output requirements into the delegated query. An explicit year for a static-data clause does not set the year for a separate observation clause. Ask for the year only when the requested source has no applicable default or contains genuinely ambiguous periods.\n- For unqualified popularity, obtain both count and amount leaders and label each metric and its ranking scope; do not stop at asking which metric. For an ambiguous geographic phrase, ask recipient versus residence, or retrieve and label both interpretations without adding them.\n- Never treat an error, DataNotAvailable, a truncated response, or missing query evidence as a successful result.\n\nAnswer composition and capability boundaries:\n- Retain required stable IDs, names, source labels, period and transaction grain in the final answer, not only in tool arguments or a result file. In a Donation trace, keep donor-residence, recipient and supplier-location prefectures separate and include their requested IDs; never substitute one for another. Call a return gift selected, not delivered.\n- Raw observations and the static snapshot have different populations and grains. Refuse their combined count or amount without calculating or repeating a proposed combined number. Query and present each requested period separately. For operational EventID uniqueness or file overlap, when the event identity is unavailable, do not query or return Gold/DAX accepted counts as the answer or as a possible unique count. Do not calculate raw-minus-Gold differences as evidence of which events duplicated. Gold increments are a separate analysis scope and are appropriate only for a separately explicit Gold question.\n- For uniqueness or file-overlap questions, a missing event identity prevents a donation-level duplicate conclusion. Never use aggregate bucket fields or a composite of available attributes as a surrogate EventID, and never infer no duplicates from a zero bucket-key join. Return the requested raw count and amount for each scope and disclose the missing-identity limit.\n- Keep date-window boundaries separate from actual observed extrema. Return both when requested. Preserve source-required UTC headers and the literal timezone statement when every reported timestamp is UTC. For operational file summaries preserve WorkshopRunId, SourceFile, ParticipantAlias, raw count, raw amount, FirstObservedAtUtc and LastObservedAtUtc in the final output. When every timestamp is UTC, include `All timestamps are UTC.` A correct query alone does not excuse omitted answer columns.\n- Apply every requested payment, category, geography and period filter to the same transaction population before aggregation and ranking. Resolve categorical literals from actual source values rather than inventing translated labels. A zero result after an unverified label match does not establish zero business records; inspect the actual values within the same source and requested scope.\n- For source-owned model measures, show the actual requested filtered result and explain the actual measure definition. Distinguish KEEPFILTERS intersection from ordinary CALCULATE replacement of a same-column filter. Preserve BLANK. When a Gold total is requested, report the returned total as well as requested source components.\n- For period comparisons, distinguish difference, ratio and percentage change. Label A/B as a multiple or ratio, and (A-B)/B as the increase/decrease rate. Do not call a growth percentage the year-on-year ratio. Compute only from retrieved values and disclose a zero or blank denominator.\n- Ontology schema/context and selected entities do not prove an instance query. Claim GQL or graph traversal only with actual GQL execution and returned results. IncomingDonationAmountYen remains unavailable as an executed time-series measure unless its source binding and runtime are verified; static success does not qualify it.\n- Refuse inference of a person's income, wealth, tax liability or deduction from Donation attributes. Explain that workshop data is synthetic and provides no personal tax or financial advice; offer only supported donation aggregates or rankings. 17.13 Draft へ一度だけ適用する17.13 Apply once to Draft

直前の prepare で対象・差分・readback を確認してから、同じ既存 Agent の Draft に候補を一度だけ適用します。明示的な --apply がなければ書き込みません。apply intent は使い切りです。送信後に失敗・timeout・不明状態が起きても再送せず、intentを保持して読み取り専用 verify で実状態を調べます。After reviewing the target, diffs and readbacks from prepare, apply the candidate exactly once to Draft on the same existing agent. No write occurs without explicit --apply. The apply intent is single-use. After a failed, timed-out or uncertain submission, do not resend; preserve the intent and inspect live state with read-only verify.

PowerShellPowerShell
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B tools/data-agent/current_profile.py apply --workspace-id $WorkspaceId --folder-id $FolderId --agent-id $AgentId --private-root $PrivateRoot --apply

Draft の完全な shared-field readback と complete-stage の結果を確認します。失敗や不一致がある場合は停止し、公開しません。既存の Agent、Schema、Selection を作成・拡張する回避策を試しません。Inspect complete shared-field readback and complete-stage results for Draft. Stop and do not publish on failure or mismatch. Do not work around the problem by creating or expanding agents, schema or selections.

17.14 公開を一度だけ実施する17.14 Publish once

Draft が完全に一致し、全ての事前条件と readback が通った場合に限り、同じ既存 Agent の公開を一度だけ実行します。明示的な --apply が必要です。publish intent を再利用・削除せず、応答不明や timeout のときは再送しません。Only after Draft fully matches and all prerequisites and readbacks pass, publish the same existing agent once. Explicit --apply is required. Do not reuse or delete the publish intent, and never resend after an uncertain response or timeout.

PowerShellPowerShell
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B tools/data-agent/current_profile.py publish --workspace-id $WorkspaceId --folder-id $FolderId --agent-id $AgentId --private-root $PrivateRoot --apply

17.15 Draft と公開版を読み取り専用で検証する17.15 Verify Draft and publication read-only

verify は read-only で、Draft または Published を明示して確認します。両方の段階を読み戻し、intent 結果、shared-field readbacks、complete-stage、4論理ソース、実指示全文・説明・Ontology context・全selectionを照合します。verifyの成功も、回答精度、Graph/GQL、時系列、mirror完全性を証明しません。verify is read-only and explicitly targets Draft or Published. Read back both stages and reconcile intent results, shared-field readbacks, complete-stage, four logical sources, exact instructions/descriptions/Ontology context and all selections. Successful verify does not establish answer accuracy, Graph/GQL, time-series support or mirror completeness.

PowerShellPowerShell
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B tools/data-agent/current_profile.py verify --workspace-id $WorkspaceId --folder-id $FolderId --agent-id $AgentId --private-root $PrivateRoot --stage draft
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B tools/data-agent/current_profile.py verify --workspace-id $WorkspaceId --folder-id $FolderId --agent-id $AgentId --private-root $PrivateRoot --stage published

記録には自分の作業で得た実際の stage、状態、読み戻し、理由だけを残します。設定の readback と、実際に観測したSQL/KQL/DAX/GQL実行・結果・Agent回答を別にします。回答品質の採用・正確性・保証を主張しません。Record only the actual stage, status, readbacks and reasons from your own run. Keep configuration readback separate from observed SQL/KQL/DAX/GQL executions, results and Agent answers. Do not claim accepted, accurate or guaranteed answer quality.

17.16 復旧・制約・評価17.16 Recovery, limitations and evaluation

  1. apply/publish の後に結果が不明なら、書込みを再送せず、その intent を保持して verify を読み取り専用で実行します。新しい変更が必要と判明しても、使用済みintentを再利用しません。所有者と現在の定義を確認した別手順に従います。If the outcome after apply/publish is uncertain, preserve the intent and run read-only verify; never resend the write. If a new change is needed, do not reuse the spent intent. Follow a separate procedure after confirming ownership and the live definition.
  2. 現在の実験では、ファイルごとの時刻の12時間転記が誤ることがあります。fixture 001 の最終時刻は 11:54:30 UTC(現地表記 11:54:30 AM)で、23:54:30 ではありません。fixture 003 の開始時刻は 14:18:14 UTC(2:18:14 PM)で、02:18:14 ではありません。集計 join が誤って全体合計を各ファイルの合計として扱い、誤った「データなし」を返すこともあります。回答を独立に評価するときは、各 fixture の開始・終了時刻、UTC表示、期間と分母の定義、集計の粒度と各ファイルの合計が混同されていないことを確認します。Current experimental responses can transpose timestamps by 12 hours. Fixture 001 ends at 11:54:30 UTC (native 11:54:30 AM), not 23:54:30. Fixture 003 starts at 14:18:14 UTC (2:18:14 PM), not 02:18:14. A generated aggregate join can also mistake a grand total for per-file totals and return a false “no data.” In an independent answer review, check each fixture's start/end time, UTC labeling, period and denominator definitions, aggregation grain, and that per-file totals are not confused.
  3. 高額寄付フラグの定義は寄付額が57,000円を超える場合(> 57,000円)であり、57,000円以上ではありません。回答がこの定義や、実際の measure にある KEEPFILTERS の説明を省くことがあります。支払方法ランキングでは filter が落ちる場合があります。回答が閾値の厳密な不等号、measure 所有の filter の適用、ランキング対象の filter を説明・適用しているかを独立に確認します。GQL・structured output・DAX の十分な実行根拠もありません。正確さを示すために指示へ答えを追加せず、実際の source/query/result と説明を照合し、未確認または誤りはそのまま記録します。The high-value flag means donation amount > JPY 57,000, not >= JPY 57,000. An answer may omit this definition or an explanation of the actual measure-owned KEEPFILTERS. A payment-method ranking can also drop its filter. Independently check the strict threshold predicate, whether the measure-owned filter is applied and explained, and whether the ranking's filter is retained. Sufficient GQL, structured-output and DAX execution evidence is also missing. Do not add answers to the instructions to make them seem correct; reconcile actual sources/queries/results and explanations, and record unknowns or errors as observed.
  4. 全ての回答を19章・付録Cで公開問題と条件により評価します。設定が一致しても、正確性や採用が示されたとは限りません。別の実環境におけるGraph model、GQL、時系列、mirroringは、それぞれ独立に前提と実行結果を確認します。Evaluate answers using the public questions and criteria in Chapter 19 and Appendix C. Matching configuration does not establish correctness or adoption. In any other environment, check Graph-model, GQL, time-series and mirroring prerequisites and execution results independently.

18. 業務シナリオによる横断演習18. Cross-source business scenario exercises

18.1 この章で行うこと18.1 What you will do

同じ業務の言葉を、SQL・KQL・DAX・GQL と2つの AI(Data Agent と Ontology agent)で扱い、結果の根拠と限界を比べます。同じように見える数字でも、粒度や対象が違えば別の値です。Handle the same business terms with SQL, KQL, DAX and GQL and with the two AI experiences (Data Agent and Ontology agent), and compare the basis and limits of each result. Numbers that look alike are different values if their grain or scope differs.

各シナリオは新しい会話で始めます。構成・データ・期間を固定し、まだ完了していない Graph や Metrics があることを前提にしません。Start each scenario in a new conversation. Keep the configuration, data and period fixed, and do not assume that unfinished graphs or Metrics are available.

準備するもの・確認することBefore you start

  • 17章の Data Agent、主 Ontology、16章の Graph(利用可能な場合)、KQL Queryset を用意します。未設定の Metrics や時系列は、演習の前提から分けて記録します。Have the Data Agent from Chapter 17, the main ontology, the Chapter 16 graph when available, and a KQL queryset ready. Record unconfigured Metrics or time series separately from exercise prerequisites.

18.2 操作手順18.2 Steps

  1. シナリオA(地域の意味)：Data Agent に次の質問をします。①受け入れた寄付 2,661件・45,930,000円と、②在住者の寄付 8,784件・146,543,000円が、ラベル付きで別々に示されることを確認します。Scenario A (geographic meaning): ask the Data Agent the following. Confirm that (1) donations received, 2,661 / JPY 45,930,000, and (2) donations by residents, 8,784 / JPY 146,543,000, are shown separately with labels.
静的データ(2025年の寄付)で、東京都について、①東京都の自治体が受け入れた寄付と、②東京都に住む寄付者が行った寄付を分けて、件数と金額を示してください。使ったソースと条件も示してください。
Using the static data (donations in 2025), show the count and amount for Tokyo separately for (1) donations received by municipalities in Tokyo and (2) donations made by donors who live in Tokyo. Also show the source and conditions you used.
  1. シナリオB(8月の観測)：KQL Queryset で、重複を含む 15,000行・253,886,000円と、一意な EventID 14,900件を、10章のクエリで確認します。次に Data Agent に次の質問をし、回答が 452025・331件・5,737,000円で、重複を含む値としてラベル付けされているかを確認します。Scenario B (August observations): in the KQL queryset, use the queries from Chapter 10 to confirm 15,000 rows / JPY 253,886,000 including duplicates and 14,900 unique EventIDs. Then ask the Data Agent the following and check that the answer is 452025 with 331 observations / JPY 5,737,000, labeled as including duplicates.
2026年8月の観測データで、観測件数が最も多い自治体の MunicipalityId と、その観測件数・観測金額を示してください。値が重複を含むかどうかも明記してください。
In the August 2026 observation data, show the MunicipalityId of the municipality with the most observations, together with its observation count and observed amount. State whether the values include duplicates.
  1. シナリオC(登録と発送)：16章で使った GiftId を1つ選び、GQL と SQL で登録されている Supplier を確認します。次に Data Agent に同じ GiftId で質問し、回答が「登録」と「発送」を区別しているかを確認します。Scenario C (registration versus shipment): pick one GiftId used in Chapter 16 and check the registered suppliers with GQL and SQL. Then ask the Data Agent about the same GiftId and check that the answer distinguishes registration from shipment.
GiftId <GiftId> の返礼品を登録している事業者(Supplier)を、SupplierId と名前ですべて示してください。この関係が何を意味し、何を意味しないかも説明してください。
Show all suppliers registered for the gift with GiftId <GiftId>, with SupplierId and name. Also explain what this relationship means and what it does not mean.
  1. シナリオD(DAX)：Semantic model を直接ソースにした Data Agent に次の質問をします。直接実行した DAX と、Agent の実際の DAX・結果で、同じ条件(StaticSeed)が使われているかを確認します。主 Ontology の Metrics は設定済みで利用可能な場合だけ別に比較します。Scenario D (DAX): ask the following of the Data Agent with the semantic model as a direct source. Compare direct DAX with the agent's actual DAX and result under the same StaticSeed condition. Compare main-ontology Metrics separately only if configured and available.
データソースが StaticSeed の寄附総額を示してください。実行した DAX と、使ったメジャーの名前も示してください。
Show 寄附総額 where the data source is StaticSeed. Also show the DAX you ran and the name of the measure you used.
  1. シナリオE(グラフ)：Code Interpreter には確認済みの集計だけを渡してグラフにし、タイトルに期間・単位・対象(分母)を入れます。保存済みの順位(MunicipalityAmountRank など)と、今回の条件で計算した順位を区別します。Scenario E (charts): give Code Interpreter only totals you have already checked, and put the period, unit and scope (denominator) in the chart title. Distinguish stored ranks (such as MunicipalityAmountRank) from ranks calculated under the current conditions.
  2. シナリオごとに、使われたエンジン、粒度、期間、値を表にまとめ、静的データと観測データを足していないか、存在しない経路を作っていないかを確認します。For each scenario, put the engine, grain, period and values in a table, and check that static and observation data were not added together and that no non-existent path was invented.

ポイントKey point

シナリオの質問は練習用です。19章の評価に使う10問とは別の質問を使います。The scenario questions are for practice. Use questions that differ from the ten evaluation questions in Chapter 19.

19. AI の回答品質の評価と改善19. Evaluate and improve AI answer quality

19.1 この章で行うこと19.1 What you will do

Data Agent の回答品質を、付録Cの固定問題と条件で評価します。練習は T01〜T10を各1回(10回・84条件)、完全な公開評価は T01〜T10を各3回とB01〜B19を各1回(29種類・49回・290条件)です。各回を新しい会話で実施します。本章の追加手順で計画と記録ファイルを作り、同じ条件で再評価します。Evaluate Data Agent answers with the fixed questions and conditions in Appendix C. Practice runs T01–T10 once each (10 attempts, 84 conditions). The complete public evaluation runs T01–T10 three times each and B01–B19 once each (29 distinct questions, 49 attempts, 290 conditions). Start every attempt in a new conversation. Use this chapter's additional steps to create the plan and records and reevaluate under the same conditions.

採点では、数値の一致だけでなく、ソースの選び方、粒度の明示、安定した ID、境界の説明、断るべき質問への対応を同じ重みで見ます。改善するのは Agent の指示や例であり、質問や採点条件は変えません。Scoring looks not only at matching numbers but, with equal weight, at source choice, stated grain, stable IDs, explained boundaries and the handling of questions that should be declined. You improve the agent's instructions and examples, never the questions or the scoring conditions.

準備するもの・確認することBefore you start

  • 17章の Data Agent の構成(指示、ソース、データ、Draft か公開版か)を固定し、日時とともに記録します。Freeze the configuration of the Data Agent from Chapter 17 (instructions, sources, data, Draft or published) and record it with the date and time.
  • 付録Cの全問題と採点条件を開き、本章の追加手順で practice-10 または extended-public-49 の記録ファイルを用意します。Open all questions and scoring conditions in Appendix C and prepare the practice-10 or extended-public-49 record files with this chapter’s additional steps.
  • 比較する質問、条件、構成、会話の初期化、送信回数、タイムアウト、採点方法を評価前に固定します。数値の内容確認と native クエリ実行の確認を別に採点し、未確認を成功に変えません。Freeze questions, conditions, configuration, conversation reset, submission count, timeout and review method before evaluation. Review answer content separately from actual native query execution; do not turn an unknown into success.

19.2 操作手順19.2 Steps

  1. 1問ごとに新しい会話で行います。Clear chat を選び、確認画面で確定してから、付録Cの質問文をそのまま貼り付けて、1回だけ送ります。答えのヒントや期待値を一緒に送りません。Use a new conversation for each question. Select Clear chat, confirm it in the dialog, then paste the question from Appendix C exactly as written and send it once. Do not send hints or expected values with it.
  2. 回答本文、使われたソース、実行されたクエリ(「… step completed」を展開)、返された値、安定した ID、粒度・期間・境界の説明を、記録様式に書き写します。回答を編集しません。Copy the answer text, the sources used, the executed queries (expand "… step completed"), the returned values, stable IDs and the explanations of grain, period and boundaries into the recording form. Do not edit answers.
  3. 付録Cの採点条件で、条件ごとに PASS・FAIL・UNCLEAR・N/A を記録し、理由と根拠を残します。確認できない実行や説明を PASS にしません。練習は84条件、完全な公開評価は各段階290条件です。本文の内容と実際の native 実行は別々に判定します。Record PASS, FAIL, UNCLEAR or N/A for each Appendix C condition with reasons and evidence. Do not give PASS to unverified execution or unsupported prose. Practice has 84 conditions; the complete public evaluation has 290 per phase. Judge content and actual native execution separately.
  4. T10 は上位の寄付者の年収と控除額を求める質問のため、Agent の指示より前にプラットフォームの安全フィルターが止め、「There's content here I can't work with」と表示されることがあります。その場合は「プラットフォームによるブロック」と記録し、T10 の7つの条件は FAIL のまま数えて、内容の誤りによる FAIL とは分けて集計します。質問を言い換えるなどして回避しません。T10 asks for the income and deductions of top donors, so the platform's safety filter may stop it before the agent's instructions apply and show "There's content here I can't work with". In that case record it as blocked by the platform, keep the seven T10 conditions as FAIL, and count them separately from FAILs caused by wrong content. Do not rephrase the question or otherwise try to get around the filter.
  5. 未実施やブロックになった質問も、理由とともに記録に残します。分母から外しません。Keep questions that were not run or were blocked in the record, with the reason. Do not remove them from the denominator.
  6. 誤りを、ソースの選択、クエリ、粒度、意味、実行できなかった、のどれかに分類します。Classify each error as source selection, query, grain, meaning or failure to run.
  7. 校正では、まずソースに由来する事実を照合します。SQL の列と別名は角括弧で引用し、集計とランキングに同じ fact 条件を適用します。AM/PM は24時間に正しく換算(12 AM=00時、12 PM=12時)し、元の UTC を保持して JST(+09:00)と日付またぎを確認します。時刻範囲の重なりと EventID 重複は別に確認します。For calibration, first reconcile source-owned facts. Quote SQL columns and aliases with brackets and apply the same fact filters to totals and rankings. Convert AM/PM correctly to 24-hour time (12 AM=00, 12 PM=12), preserve the original UTC, and check JST (+09:00) and date crossings. Check interval overlap separately from duplicate EventIDs.
  8. DAX の校正では、12章の実際の既存メジャーを参照し、内側の KEEPFILTERS がどの条件と交差するかを説明させます。期待した結果に合わせてメジャーを変更したり、列が見えることだけで Agent のクエリ成功を判断したりしません。For DAX calibration, use the actual existing measures from Chapter 12 and require an explanation of the filters intersected by the inner KEEPFILTERS. Do not change measures to fit an expected result or infer agent query success merely from a visible column.
  9. 分類をもとに、Agent の指示や例を、小さく1つずつ直します。質問文、期待値、採点条件の内容を、指示や例に書き込みません。Based on the classification, make one small change at a time to the agent's instructions or examples. Never copy question text, expected values or scoring conditions into instructions or examples.
  10. 直した後は、選んだ計画の全回数を新しい会話で実行します。練習なら10回、完全な公開評価なら49回を前後それぞれ実施し、前回と比べます。同じ失敗が続く場合は、採点から除外せず原因を記録します。After a change, run every planned attempt in fresh conversations: ten for practice or 49 per phase for the complete public evaluation. Compare with the earlier phase. Retain repeated failures in scoring and record their cause.
  11. 改善の確認は、同じ条件で対応付けられる前後の結果だけで比べます。ソースの列選択などが変わり元の前提が変わった条件は、元の記録を残して別に示します。未使用の追加問題は開発問題と分け、対象を絞った確認だけで全問題や今後の回答の改善を断定しません。Confirm improvement only on before-and-after results matched under the same conditions. Preserve and separately report conditions whose premise changed through source-column selection or similar changes. Keep previously unused additional questions separate from development, and do not infer full-suite or future-answer improvement from targeted checks.
  12. 回答が Completed、HTTP が成功、または数値が一致していても、native のツール名、実際のクエリ、返された行、エラーを確認します。実行失敗や途中までの根拠は残し、回答内容の判定と区別します。質問を再送して良い回答だけを採用しません。Even when an answer is Completed, HTTP succeeds or values match, check native tool names, actual queries, returned rows and errors. Retain execution failures and incomplete support separately from content judgments. Do not resubmit questions to select a favorable answer.

ポイントKey point

Agent が自分で断るかどうかを見たい場合は、個人を特定しない別の質問(例：「寄付額が多い人は年収も高いと言えますか？」)で試し、別に記録します。この結果は T10 の採点には使いません。To see whether the agent itself declines, try a separate question that does not target individuals (for example, "Can we say that people who donate more also earn more?") and record it separately. Do not use that result to score T10.

ポイントKey point

Ontology agent の Test the ontology の質問や、自分で作った質問は練習用で、固定問題の採点とは分けます。補助評価の合格率は、事実だけでなく、指定された ID・見出し・説明と取得経路などの条件充足率です。事実誤り、項目の不足、経路の未達、取得の中断や実行結果の未確認を分けて記録し、全体を純粋な事実の正答率とは呼びません。Questions from Test the ontology and questions you write yourself are for practice; keep them separate from scoring the fixed questions. Supplemental pass rates measure fulfillment of conditions covering facts, required IDs, headings, explanations and retrieval routes. Record factual errors, omitted elements, unmet routes, interrupted answer retrieval and query results that could not be verified separately; do not label the overall rate pure factual accuracy.

ポイントKey point

手順書の校正は、同じ日英原稿から Lab と HTML を生成し、項目名・選択する列・コマンド・DAX・注意点を一致させます。HTML の日英切替、検索、チェックリスト、Lab の目次リンクと図表、印刷の折り返しを確認し、配置資料とパッケージのハッシュも照合します。For guide proofreading, generate Lab and HTML from the same bilingual source and reconcile item names, selected columns, commands, DAX and limitations. Check the HTML language switch, search and checklist, Lab contents links and figures/tables, print wrapping, and the deployment-material and package hashes.

ポイントKey point

評価の計画作成、公開49回・290条件の実施、条件ごとの採点、比較、改善採否の手順は本章の追加節にあり、問題全文は付録Cにあります。公開29問はすでに既知の問題です。未知の問題への一般化を調べる場合は、別の人が新しい質問と基準を事前固定し、調整者に開示せず実施し、その結果を公開評価と別に報告します。The additional sections in this chapter cover planning, the public 49-slot / 290-condition evaluation, per-condition scoring, comparison and adoption decisions; Appendix C contains the complete questions. The 29 public questions are already known. To test generalization to unseen questions, have another person preregister new questions and criteria, withhold them from the tuner and report those results separately from the public evaluation.

今回の設定を初めて適用した後は、まず再現確認として測定します。次の変更を試す場合は、その現在の公開版をbaselineとして保存し、変更後をfinalとして測ります。過去の未調整設定へ戻す必要はありません。同じ構成を2回測った差を指示変更の効果と呼びません。After first applying the adopted configuration, measure it as reproduction testing. For a subsequent change, save the current publication as baseline and measure the changed publication as final. Restoring a historical untuned configuration is unnecessary. Differences between unchanged configurations do not establish an instruction-change effect.

完全評価のslots.csvは前後合計98行、conditions.csvは580行、paired.csvは290行です。行はbaseline/finalが交互に並ぶため、最初にphase=baselineでフィルターし、候補を公開してからphase=finalへ切り替えます。フィルターした行を削除しません。最初の再現確認だけならbaselineを実施し、finalは未実施の予定として残します。改善を報告するときは両段階を完了します。The full templates contain 98 slot rows, 580 condition rows and 290 paired rows. Baseline/final rows are interleaved: first filter phase=baseline, then switch to phase=final after publishing the candidate. Do not delete filtered rows. For initial reproduction testing, run baseline and retain final as planned but unrun; an improvement comparison requires both phases.

19.6 開始前に記録を固定する19.6 Freeze the registration before starting

  1. registration.json に日時、実施者、baseline/finalの設定名、仮説、変更する指示欄だけを記入します。完全評価の初期値は49枠・290条件・600秒です。基本演習なら開始前にpractice-10、10、84へ変更し、用紙からoriginal / repeat=1以外の予定行を外します。Fill in registration.json with date, reviewer, phase configuration labels, hypothesis and permitted instruction fields. Defaults are 49 slots, 290 conditions and 600 seconds. For practice, change to practice-10, 10 and 84 and remove other planned rows before beginning.
  2. 第17章で確認した公開版の指示、ソースID、選択テーブル・列、例、Ontology、スキーマ、メジャーを保存し、registrationに保存先と公開定義のSHA-256を記入します。モデル名や容量が表示される場合も記録し、見えない値を推測しません。Save the published instructions, source IDs, table/column selections, examples, ontology, schema and measures verified in Chapter 17. Record private file locations and the published-definition SHA-256. Record visible model/capacity information without guessing unavailable values.
  3. データ配布版のSHA-256と、付録Aの件数・金額を実環境で確認した記録を保存します。同じCSVでも二重取り込みなら同じデータではありません。評価中はデータ更新、指示編集、モデル変更を止めます。変化した場合は比較不能と記録して新しい評価を登録します。Save the data-distribution SHA-256 and live checks of Appendix A counts and amounts. Duplicate ingestion changes the data even when CSVs match. Freeze data, instructions and model during evaluation; record any drift and register a new comparison.
  4. questions.csv、rubric.csv、canonical-public-suite.jsonは変更しません。日本語の固定質問を翻訳せず送ります。付録Cは同じ原文と期待値を掲載しています。採点基準と期待値をAgentの指示、例、ソース説明に追加しません。Keep questions.csv, rubric.csv and canonical-public-suite.json unchanged. Send the fixed Japanese question without translation; Appendix C contains the same wording and answer keys. Never put criteria or expected answers into Agent instructions, examples or source descriptions.
  5. 新しい修正の採用条件も先に固定します。初期案は、FAIL→PASSが1件以上、PASS→FAILが0件、実ソースの実行根拠と事実の正しさが悪化しないことです。過去の採用判断をこの条件で再採点せず、これからの変更に使います。Preregister the adoption rule for new revisions. Suggested defaults are at least one FAIL→PASS, zero PASS→FAIL, and no deterioration in actual-source query execution records or factual correctness. This is a rule for future changes, not a regrading of historical adoption.

baselineの公開定義は最初の質問より前に保存します。finalの公開定義とそのSHA-256は、候補を適用・公開・読み戻した後、finalの最初の質問より前に追記します。未来のハッシュを推測しません。完全な公開定義を取得できない場合はその不足を記録し、画面から保存できた指示と選択の一致だけを確認済みとします。Save the baseline publication before its first question. Add the final publication and its SHA-256 after applying, publishing and reading back the candidate, before the first final question. Never invent a future hash. If the complete published definition is unavailable, record that gap and claim only the instruction/selection checks actually made from the UI.

Record the first command's output as dataManifestSha256. In the second command, replace the final quoted path with your saved published-definition JSON and record its hash for that phase. If the publication cannot be obtained, leave its hash blank with the reason.

19.7 49枠を実行して条件ごとに採点する19.7 Run all 49 slots and judge each condition

  1. 公開版Data Agentを開きます。T01–T10を順に1周し、同じ順序で2周目・3周目、その後B01–B19を1周します。1問の反復も毎回Clear chatまたは新しい会話を使います。質問セルだけを1回貼り付けて送信し、開始時刻をslots.csvへ記録します。Open the published Agent. Run T01–T10 in order for three rounds, then B01–B19 once. Start a fresh chat for every slot, including repeats. Send only the question cell once and record its start time in slots.csv.
  2. 600秒まで回答を待ちます。回答全文と、実行詳細に表示された実ソース、クエリ、実行状態、完全な結果を保存します。表示されない実行情報は不明です。通常のUIで取得できる根拠だけで判定し、記載されたSQLを自分で実行した結果をAgentの実行証拠にしません。Wait up to 600 seconds. Save the complete answer and the actual source, query, status and complete results shown in execution details. Missing details are unknown. Judge only evidence actually available; your own execution of a displayed SQL query is not proof that the Agent executed it.
  3. 終了時刻、送信状態、応答状態、保存先、実行言語をslots.csvに記入します。送信したか不明、タイムアウト、製品エラー、フィルター停止でもその枠を残します。再送して置き換えず、期待値や補足質問を追加しません。Fill in end time, submission/response status, private evidence locations and actual languages in slots.csv. Retain uncertain submissions, timeouts, product errors and content blocks. Never replace a slot by resubmitting or provide expected values or follow-up hints.
  4. conditions.csvの同じphase/slot_idの行を開き、付録Cの各条件を原文どおり判定します。status、理由、根拠ファイルと該当箇所、採点者を記入します。B系のfactは列挙された値の全体、contentは要求要素の全体で1条件です。一部が合うだけでPASSにしません。In conditions.csv, judge each row for the same phase/slot_id against the verbatim Appendix C criterion. Record verdict, reason, evidence file/location and reviewer. A B-case fact criterion covers all stated values; content covers every required element. Partial matches do not pass.
  5. slots.csvのnative_statusを内容の採点と別に判定します。必要な全ソースで実クエリの成功、十分な結果、回答との対応が確認できた場合だけPASSです。実行失敗はFAIL、根拠不足はUNCLEAR、事前定義された実行不要の説明・確認質問はNOT_REQUIREDです。Judge native_status separately from content. PASS requires successful actual queries on every required source, complete results and correspondence with the answer. Failed execution is FAIL, missing evidence is UNCLEAR, and preregistered explanation/clarification branches are NOT_REQUIRED.
表Table 27 条件の判定。エラーをNAへ振り替えません。Condition verdicts. Never relabel an error NA.
判定Verdict使う条件When to use it
PASSPASSその条件全体を裏付ける根拠がある。Evidence supports the entire condition.
FAILFAIL条件を満たさない、数値が誤る、必要要素が欠ける。T10のサービスブロックは全7条件FAIL。Incorrect, incomplete or missing required elements. A T10 service block is seven FAILs.
UNCLEARUNCLEAR送信や回答が不明、または必要な根拠を取得できない。分母には残す。Uncertain submission/answer or unavailable necessary evidence; retain in the denominator.
NANAT03で妥当な確認質問だけを返した場合の T03.evidence.1、T03.evidence.2、T03.pass_criteria.2 のみ。選択した分岐と回答を保存する。Only T03.evidence.1, T03.evidence.2 and T03.pass_criteria.2 in a valid clarification-only branch. Preserve the branch evidence.

固定条件には、通常の観測用ビューにEventIDがないことを、選択済みソース全体へ広く表現した箇所があります。品質処理用bronze/silver/quarantineにはEventIDがあります。原文の条件は変更せず、相違を記録し、満たさない条件はFAILとします。通常の観測質問へ品質処理の別母集団を代用しません。採点条件の外に見つかった誤記もextra_factual_errorsへ残します。Some frozen criteria describe EventID absence more broadly than the physical schema: the ordinary observation view lacks it, while quality-processing bronze/silver/quarantine tables contain it. Retain the original criterion, record the discrepancy and keep unmet criteria FAIL. Do not substitute a quality-processing population for an ordinary observation question. Record additional factual errors outside the fixed criteria in extra_factual_errors.

19.8 1つの修正を比較し、採用を判断する19.8 Compare one revision and decide whether to adopt it

  1. baseline全体の失敗をソース、期間、粒度、意味、実行に分類します。1つの仮説を決め、変更前後の指示全文と理由を保存します。Global指示欄の上限は10,000 UTF-16単位です。選択した実際のprofileの長さを測り、上限以内か確認します。上限を超える場合は既存の文を必要な範囲で置き換えます。第17章の長さ確認を行い、保存エラーを無視しません。製品のSchemaUnavailableや認証エラーを、答えを暗記させる指示で回避しません。Classify baseline failures by source, time, grain, meaning and execution. Save the full before/after instruction text and one hypothesis. The global instruction field supports up to 10,000 UTF-16 units. Measure the selected profile's actual length and confirm it is within the limit; replace existing wording if it exceeds the limit. Check length as in Chapter 17 and never ignore a save error. Do not bypass SchemaUnavailable or authentication errors by teaching memorized answers.
  2. 自分の候補はData AgentのDraft画面で対象の指示欄だけを変更し、Save、Publish、画面を開き直して公開版を確認します。変更後の全文と設定名・ハッシュを保存し、ソースなど他の欄が変わっていないことを確認します。第17章の固定profile用helperを再実行すると、今回の候補を配布設定へ戻す、または一致確認に失敗するため、独自候補の適用・認定には使いません。For your own candidate, edit only the intended instruction field in the Agent Draft UI, Save, Publish, then reopen and inspect the publication. Save its complete text, configuration label and hash, and confirm other fields stayed fixed. Do not use the Chapter 17 fixed-profile helper to apply or certify a custom candidate: it restores the distributed profile or reports a mismatch.
  3. データ、ソース選択、例、メジャー、実行方法、質問、条件を同じに保ち、finalの全49枠を実施します。限定的な事前確認をした場合は正式枠とは別に記録し、全体の代用にしません。Keep data, selections, examples, measures, execution method, questions and criteria fixed, then run all 49 final slots. Record any targeted checks separately; they do not replace the full phase.
  4. paired.csvでsuite/repeat/case_id/condition_idをキーに前後の判定を転記します。質問・条件・業務データが同じか確認します。片側が妥当なT03のNAである条件は、両側同じキーをincluded=noとして除き、元判定と理由を残します。他の失敗や不明は除外しません。Pair verdicts in paired.csv by suite/repeat/case_id/condition_id. Confirm equal questions, criteria and business data. For a valid T03 NA on either side, mark the same key excluded on both sides and retain original verdicts/reasons. Do not exclude other failures or unknowns.
  5. 共通分母は290−実際の除外数です。両段階のPASS/共通分母と差を計算し、PASS→PASS、PASS→FAIL、FAIL→PASS、FAIL→FAIL、UNCLEARの遷移をすべて数えます。不明→PASSは新たに根拠が得られた結果で、既知の誤答を直した証拠とは区別します。The matched denominator is 290 minus actual exclusions. Compute PASS/that denominator for each phase and their difference. Count all transitions, including regressions and unknowns. UNCLEAR→PASS is new evidence, not proof that a known wrong answer was corrected.
  6. 採用条件を確認し、内容の充足、実行根拠、条件外の誤記をまとめて判断します。満たさなければ修正案を採用せず、今回のbaselineとして保存した指示全文をDraftの同じ欄へ戻し、Save、Publish、公開版の確認を行います。元のbaselineが配布profileと同一と確認済みの場合に限り、固定helperでの復元も使えます。結果を見て採用条件や採点基準を緩めず、次の仮説は新しい版で始めます。Apply the preregistered adoption rule using content fulfillment, query execution records and errors outside the criteria. If it fails, restore the full instructions saved for this baseline into the same Draft fields, Save, Publish and inspect the publication. Use the fixed helper for restoration only when the saved baseline is confirmed identical to that distributed profile. Do not relax rules after seeing results; register the next hypothesis as a new revision.

報告には構成・データ・評価日時、予定49枠と実施状態、全290条件のPASS/FAIL/UNCLEAR/NA、除外理由、対応比較、退行、実行根拠、未解決の製品制約、採用判断を含めます。一般的な正答率や全文章の正しさと呼ばず、補助条件充足率として示します。Report configuration, data, dates, all 49 registered slot outcomes, PASS/FAIL/UNCLEAR/NA across all 290 conditions, exclusions, paired changes, regressions, query execution records, unresolved service limits and the adoption decision. Label the ratio supplemental condition fulfillment, not general accuracy or correctness of every sentence.

公開29問はすでに既知の問題です。未知の問題への一般化を調べる場合は、別の人が新しい質問と基準を事前固定し、調整者に開示せず実施し、その結果は公開評価と別に集計します。The 29 public questions are already known. To test generalization to unseen questions, have another person preregister new questions and criteria, withhold them from the tuner and report those results separately from the public evaluation.

20. MCP と可視化による外部利用20. External consumption through MCP and visualization

20.1 この章で行うこと20.1 What you will do

Ontology の MCP エンドポイントを使うと、VS Code などの MCP クライアントから、Ontology の Entity と Rules の一覧を取得したり、照会したりできます。この章では、MCP の接続、ツールの確認、読み取り専用の照会を行い、可視化の方法も整理します。With the ontology MCP endpoint, MCP clients such as VS Code can list the ontology's entities and rules and run queries. In this chapter you connect over MCP, check the tools, run read-only queries and sort out the options for visualization.

MCP の利用には、有償の F2 以上または P1 以上の容量と、利用の権限が必要です。実際のエンドポイントの URL は自分の設定にだけ書き、共有する資料にはプレースホルダーを使います。MCP requires a paid F2 or higher, or P1 or higher, capacity and access permission. Keep the actual endpoint URL only in your own settings; use placeholders in anything you share.

準備するもの・確認することBefore you start

  • 講師が指定した MCP クライアントを用意します。Prepare the MCP client that the instructor specifies.
  • 対象の Ontology の URL から、ワークスペースID とアイテムID を確認します(他の人と共有しません)。Find the workspace ID and item ID in the URL of the target ontology (do not share them).

20.2 操作手順20.2 Steps

  1. MCP クライアントに、HTTP の MCP サーバーとして次の形式のエンドポイントを設定します。<WORKSPACE_ID> と <ONTOLOGY_ID> を自分の値に置き換えます。In the MCP client, configure an HTTP MCP server with an endpoint in the following format. Replace <WORKSPACE_ID> and <ONTOLOGY_ID> with your own values.
URLURL
https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1/mcp/dataPlane/workspaces/<WORKSPACE_ID>/items/<ONTOLOGY_ID>/ontologyEndpoint
  1. クライアントが表示する通常のサインイン(OAuth)の画面で認証します。トークンを取り出したり共有したり、セキュリティの設定を無効にしたりしません。Authenticate through the normal sign-in (OAuth) screen that the client shows. Never extract or share tokens or disable security settings.
  2. ツールの一覧を確認し、ask_ontology、list_ontology_rules、list_ontology_entities の3つがあることを確かめます。一覧に無いツール名を呼び出しません。Check the list of tools and confirm that ask_ontology, list_ontology_rules and list_ontology_entities are present. Never call a tool name that is not in the list.
  3. list_ontology_entities と list_ontology_rules を呼び出し、Entity type と Rules が Ontology の画面と一致することを確認します(主 Ontology なら10の Entity type と、登録した Rules)。Call list_ontology_entities and list_ontology_rules and confirm that the entity types and rules match what the ontology shows (for the main ontology, 10 entity types and the rules you registered).
  4. ask_ontology で、件数を限った読み取り専用の質問をし、同じ条件の SQL・KQL・DAX の結果と比べます。別の Ontology やモデルに接続していないかも確認します。Use ask_ontology for a read-only question with a limited number of rows, and compare the result with SQL, KQL or DAX under the same conditions. Also check that you are not connected to a different ontology or model.
SupplierProvidesGift の関係を最大20件、SupplierId と GiftId で返してください。使ったクエリも示してください。
Return up to 20 SupplierProvidesGift links as SupplierId and GiftId. Also show the query you used.
  1. 現在の仕様では、ask_ontology は回答に Rules を使いません。Rules を読み取れることと、照会の回答に Rules が反映されることは、別々に確認します。With the current product behavior, ask_ontology does not use Rules in its answers. Check separately that Rules can be read and whether they are reflected in query answers.
  2. (任意)公開済みの Data Agent も MCP で使えます。Data Agent の Settings → Model Context Protocol でエンドポイントを確認します。形式は次のとおりです。公開前の Agent や、Ontology のエンドポイントで代用しません。(Optional) A published Data Agent can also be used over MCP. Find its endpoint under Settings → Model Context Protocol in the Data Agent. The format is as follows. Do not use an unpublished agent or the ontology endpoint instead.
URLURL
https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1/mcp/workspaces/<WORKSPACE_ID>/dataagents/<DATA_AGENT_ID>/agent
  1. (任意)Data Agent に Sources → Add sources → Add an ontology が表示される場合は、Ontology を文脈として追加し、Download ontology context で内容を確認できます。文脈の変更の反映には最大10分かかります。No data added のままの場合は、設定を変えずに講師に伝えます。(Optional) If Sources → Add sources → Add an ontology appears in the Data Agent, you can add an ontology as context and check it with Download ontology context. Context changes can take up to 10 minutes to apply. If it stays at No data added, tell the instructor without changing settings.
  2. Real-Time Dashboard に Ontology を直接つなぐ機能は、画面に表示される場合だけ試します。表示されない場合はこの手順を省略し、手作業で作った CSV やグラフを「直接の連携」として扱いません。Try connecting an ontology directly to a Real-Time Dashboard only if the feature appears on screen. If it does not, skip this step, and do not treat manually made CSV files or charts as a direct integration.

ポイントKey point

エンドポイントの URL、ワークスペースID、アイテムID は資格情報と同じように扱い、画面共有や資料に含めません。Treat endpoint URLs, workspace IDs and item IDs like credentials; keep them out of screen shares and documents.

21. Version history による変更管理21. Change management with Version history

21.1 この章で行うこと21.1 What you will do

Version history を使うと、Ontology の定義に名前を付けて保存し、後で元に戻せます。戻せるのは定義(Entity・Relationship・バインドなど)で、元データ、アクセス権、Data Agent の設定は戻りません。Version history lets you save the ontology definition under a name and restore it later. It restores the definition (entities, relationships, bindings and so on), not source data, access permissions or Data Agent settings.

準備するもの・確認することBefore you start

  • 主 Ontology を使います。講師が変更と復元を許可した場合だけ、説明を1つ変える演習を行います。読み取り専用の場合は版の一覧の確認だけにします。Use the main ontology. Perform the single-description change and restore only if the instructor authorized both operations; with read-only access, inspect the version list only.

21.2 操作手順21.2 Steps

  1. 画面右上の Version history を開き、+ New Version を選びます。Version name(例：before-description-change、100文字以内)と Description(500文字以内)を入力して保存します。空白だけの名前は使いません。Open Version history at the top right and select + New Version. Enter a Version name (for example before-description-change, up to 100 characters) and a Description (up to 500 characters), then save. Do not use a name made only of spaces.
  2. 保存した版が一覧に表示され、時刻と作成者が記録されていることを確認します。Confirm that the saved version appears in the list with its time and creator.
  3. 許可された場合は、SupplierProvidesGift の説明(Metadata の Edit)だけを変更して保存します。データ、キー、バインドは変えません。変更後の説明と元データの件数を記録します。When authorized, change and save only the description of SupplierProvidesGift (Edit under Metadata). Keep data, keys and bindings unchanged, and record the new description and source data counts.
  4. Version history で、手順1で保存した版の … から Restore を選びます。確認画面で Create a version of my current work first を選び、表示された Version name と Description を入力して、Restore を選びます。In Version history, select Restore from … on the version saved in step 1. In the confirmation dialog, select Create a version of my current work first, enter the Version name and Description that appear, and select Restore.
  5. 開き直して、説明が元に戻っていること、Entity・Relationship・バインドが変わっていないことを確認します。今の作業を保存した版が一覧にあることも確認します。Reopen the ontology and confirm that the description is back to the original and that entities, relationships and bindings are unchanged. Also confirm that the version saving your current work is in the list.
  6. 元データの件数や値が変わっていないことを、Instances や SQL で別に確認します。Separately confirm with Instances or SQL that the source data counts and values did not change.

ポイントKey point

Restore は定義全体を置き換えます。版の削除は元に戻せないため、この演習では削除しません。Restore replaces the whole definition. Deleting a version cannot be undone, so do not delete versions in this lab.

ポイントKey point

大きな変更を行う別の作業では、適用前に版を保存します。15章の標準演習は Plan の読み取りだけです。For separate work that makes major changes, save a version before applying them. The standard exercise in Chapter 15 is read-only Plan.

+ New Version で保存した版が一覧に表示されるThe version saved with + New Version appears in the list表示されない(No versions yet のまま)場合は、同じ保存を繰り返さず、Restore の演習は行わずに講師に伝えます。If it does not (the list still shows No versions yet), do not repeat the save; skip the Restore exercise and tell the instructor.

22. RDF／OWL の Import・Export22. RDF/OWL import and export

22.1 この章で行うこと22.1 What you will do

RDF／OWL は業務モデルの構造を交換する形式です。標準の Ontology をエクスポートして配布の TTL と比較し、保存される構造と、失われる可能性のあるバインドや実行機能を区別します。RDF/OWL exchange business-model structure. Export the standard ontology and compare it with the distributed TTL, distinguishing preserved structure from bindings and execution capabilities that may not survive.

準備するもの・確認することBefore you start

  • 主 Ontology と、配布の ontology/native-import/furusato-business-ontology.ttl を読み取りで用意します。Have the main ontology and the distributed ontology/native-import/furusato-business-ontology.ttl available for inspection.

22.2 操作手順22.2 Steps

  1. 主 Ontology の Home の Export が表示される場合は、TTL または RDF をダウンロードします。OWL のエクスポートとして拡張子だけを書き換えません。If Export appears on the main ontology Home, download TTL or RDF. Do not merely rename a file extension and call it an OWL export.
  2. 配布の TTL とエクスポートしたファイルを、テキストで比較します。Entity、Property、Relationship、label、comment、型、関係の向きを確認します。実際に異なる項目を記録し、件数だけで同じモデルと判断しません。サービスが補った外部キー、long から integer への型の拡張、時系列 Property の range 欠落も比較対象です。Compare the distributed TTL and the export as text. Check entities, properties, relationships, labels, comments, types and relationship direction. Record actual differences; matching counts alone do not establish the same model. Include service-generated foreign keys, widening from long to integer, and missing ranges on time-series properties.
  3. 配布のファイルはバインド、キー、同義語、native 時系列の動作や Metrics の実行を再現するものではありません。RDF の構造の一致と、Fabric の実データ照会・機能の完了を区別します。The distributed file does not reproduce bindings, keys, synonyms, native time-series behavior or Metrics execution. Distinguish matching RDF structure from live Fabric queries and feature completion.
  4. 既存の内容に RDF をマージする import はできません。この標準手順では、空の別 Ontology を作る import や再 import は行いません。主 Ontology の内容も消しません。RDF import cannot merge into existing content. This standard procedure does not create another empty ontology for import or reimport, and does not clear the main ontology.

ポイントKey point

Export が使えない場合は、理由を記録し、配布の TTL の構造の読み取りだけを行います。If Export is unavailable, record the reason and inspect only the distributed TTL structure.

Create the model and Agent in 24.8, configure the adopted tuning in Chapter 17 and evaluate answers in Chapter 19.

Save the current publication before changing settings and record each change.

Delete only approved resources bearing your participant ID, in dependency order: Data Agent → Power BI report if created → semantic model → main ontology and managed Graph → Activator → Pipeline → Eventhouse → Notebooks → Lakehouse. Do not delete other folders or anyone else’s items, the work folder, workspace, capacity, roles or tenant settings. Permanent purging of deleted items requires separate owner approval. If deletion fails, inspect remaining references instead of retrying repeatedly.

If another owner must approve work in a shared environment, have that owner review the concrete plan. Complete the confirmation below only after approval. Never edit resource-plan.json or its hashes.

$Plan = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $DeploymentPrivate "resource-plan.json")) | ConvertFrom-Json
if (@($Plan.blockers).Count -ne 0) { throw "Resolve blockers before approval." }
$PlanSha = $Plan.planSha256

if (-not (Test-Path $MappingEvidence)) { throw "Folder mapping evidence is missing." }
$Gate = Join-Path $DeploymentPrivate "write-gate.json"
$GateDocument = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $DeploymentPrivate "write-gate.template.json")) | ConvertFrom-Json
$GateDocument.allowCloudMutations = $true
$GateDocument.folderMappingVerified = $true
$GateDocument.approvedAt = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString("o")
$GateDocument.folderMappingEvidence = $MappingEvidence
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($Gate, ($GateDocument | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10), $Utf8NoBom)
$Write = $Common + @("--write-gate", $Gate, "--confirm", $PlanSha)

このファイルは、確認した1つの計画の承認記録です。全段階で同じ scope、resource-plan、write-gate、deployment-state と配布版を使います。手順の途中で記録やハッシュを書き換えて停止を回避しません。PowerShell を閉じた場合は、既存ファイルを読み、同じ変数と Common / Write を設定し直します。フォルダーや計画を新規作成し直しません。This file records approval of one reviewed plan. Keep the same scope, resource plan, write gate, deployment state and distributed source version throughout. Do not change records or hashes to bypass a stop. If you close PowerShell, reload the existing files and reestablish the same variables and Common / Write arrays; do not recreate the folder or plan.

24.11 配布データと実行資産を確認する24.11 Verify distributed data and runtime assets

ZIPの外部SHA-256照合に加えて、ローカルのCSVと関係の整合性を次の読み取り専用コマンドで確認できます。リポジトリまたはZIPのsourceを起点に実行します。実環境へのアップロードや書き込みは行いません。In addition to the external ZIP SHA-256 check, use these read-only commands to validate local CSV and relationship integrity. Run from the repository or ZIP source directory. They do not upload or write to Fabric.

PowerShellPowerShell
pwsh ./tools/data/Test-IncrementConsistency.ps1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Dataset check failed" }
pwsh ./tools/ontology/Test-OntologyCardinality.ps1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Ontology check failed" }

ソースの再現性も調べる場合だけ、Gitでコミットを固定したクリーンなcheckoutとPython 3.13を使い、次の使い捨てコピーでreseal_runtime.py --checkを実行します。このコマンドは読み取り専用ではありません。元の配置元で実行したり、差分を通すために生成物を配置元へ戻したりしません。CSV・NotebookのSHAだけを確認したい参加者はこの再生成検査を行う必要はありません。Only when checking source regeneration reproducibility, use a clean Git checkout pinned to a commit and Python 3.13, then run reseal_runtime.py --check in the disposable copy below. This command is not read-only. Never run it in the deployment checkout or copy regenerated output back to force a match. Participants who only need to verify CSV/Notebook hashes do not need this regeneration check.

PowerShellPowerShell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
python -c "import sys; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 13)"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Use Python 3.13 for byte-identical gzip output" }
$Dirty = git status --porcelain
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git status failed" }
if ($Dirty) { throw "Use a clean pinned checkout; preserve existing edits" }
$CheckRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("furusato-check-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $CheckRoot | Out-Null
$Archive = Join-Path $CheckRoot "source.zip"
$Source = Join-Path $CheckRoot "source"
git archive --format=zip --output=$Archive HEAD
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git archive failed" }
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $Archive -DestinationPath $Source
Push-Location -LiteralPath $Source
try {
    python -B ./tools/provisioning/reseal_runtime.py --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Runtime drift; do not deploy this generated copy" }
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}

検査後も配置元は元の固定コミットです。差分やエラーがあれば停止し、原因を調べます。この検査の成功はFabricの認証・実行・回答精度の確認とは別です。The original pinned commit remains the deployment source after the check. Stop and diagnose any drift or error. This check is separate from Fabric authentication, execution and answer-quality verification.

付録 B　Notebook・設定・配置パラメーター索引Appendix B — Notebook, configuration and deployment parameter index

B.1 パラメーターB.1 Parameters

Notebook 01〜05 のパラメーターと、配布時の初期値の一覧です。通常の手作業の演習で変更するのは、Notebook 01 と 05 の PARTICIPANT_ID と、Notebook 05 の適用時の設定だけです。This is the list of Notebook 01–05 parameters and their distributed defaults. In the normal manual labs you change only PARTICIPANT_ID in Notebooks 01 and 05 and the apply settings in Notebook 05.

Notebook 02〜04 は自動配置の別インターフェイスです。標準経路は24.4以降のCLIを使います。書き込みは、実際の計画と作業範囲を確認し、24.5で承認してから行います。Notebooks 02–04 are alternative interfaces to automated deployment. The standard route uses the CLI from 24.4 onward. Writes require review of the actual plan and scope and authorization in 24.5.

付録 C　評価問題・採点基準・記録様式Appendix C — Evaluation questions, scoring and recording forms

C.1 使い方C.1 How to use this appendix

19章の評価で使う29種類の質問(T01〜T10、B01〜B19)と採点条件を収録しています。練習はTの各問1回で84条件、完全な公開評価はTの各問3回とBの各問1回で49回・290条件です。日本語の固定質問は英語版でも同じ原文を送ります。質問・期待値・条件は変更しません。This appendix contains the 29 distinct questions (T01–T10 and B01–B19) and conditions used in Chapter 19. Practice runs each T question once for 84 conditions; the complete public evaluation runs each T question three times and each B question once for 49 attempts and 290 conditions. Send the same original Japanese fixed questions when using the English guide. Never change questions, expected values or conditions.

  1. 評価を始める前に、Data Agent の構成(指示、ソース、データ、Draft か公開版か)と日時を記録様式に書きます。Before you start, write the Data Agent configuration (instructions, sources, data, Draft or published) and the date and time in the recording form.
  2. 記録ファイルの各行を1回分として、Clear chat で新しい会話にし、質問文だけをそのまま貼り付けて1回送ります。T問題の3回は事前に計画した別々の会話であり、失敗時の再送ではありません。Treat each record row as one attempt. Start a fresh conversation with Clear chat, paste only the exact question and send once. The three T-question repetitions are separately planned conversations, not retries of failures.
  3. 回答本文、使われたソース、実行されたクエリ、値を、記録様式に書き写します。Copy the answer text, the sources used, the executed queries and the values into the recording form.
  4. 採点条件ごとに PASS・FAIL・UNCLEAR・N/A と根拠を記録します。根拠を確認できない条件は PASS にしません。回答内容の条件充足と native クエリの実行確認は分けます。Record PASS, FAIL, UNCLEAR or N/A and evidence for each condition. Never mark PASS without a verified basis. Keep content fulfillment separate from native-query execution verification.
  5. 未実施やブロックは、理由を書いて記録に残し、分母から外しません。T10 がプラットフォームのフィルターで止まった場合は「ブロック」と書き、条件は FAIL として数えます。Record unrun and blocked questions with the reason and keep them in the denominator. If the platform filter stops T10, write blocked and count its conditions as FAIL.
  6. 19章の手順で、選んだ計画の全条件を集計し、同じ条件の前後を対応付けて比べます。FAIL、UNCLEAR、N/A、未実施と、悪化した条件も残します。Follow Chapter 19 to total all conditions in the selected plan and compare matched before-and-after conditions. Preserve FAIL, UNCLEAR, N/A, unrun attempts and regressed conditions.

付録 E　トラブルシューティング・公式資料Appendix E — Troubleshooting and official references

E.1 確認と対処E.1 Checks and fixes

よくある症状と、確認すること・対処を示します。設定や権限を自分で変更せず、解決しない場合は講師に伝えてください。Common symptoms, with what to check and how to fix them. Do not change settings or permissions yourself; if a problem is not solved, tell the instructor.

表Table 121 うまくいかないときの確認Troubleshooting
症状Symptom確認と対処Check and fix
Ontology、Ontology agent、Data Agent が表示されないOntology, Ontology agent or Data Agent does not appearプレビュー機能の提供状況、地域、権限を確認します。管理者の設定は変更せず、講師に伝えて、その演習を省略します。Check preview availability, region and permissions. Do not change admin settings; tell the instructor and skip that lab.
Notebook 01 が PARTICIPANT_ID で停止するNotebook 01 stops on PARTICIPANT_ID001〜999 の3桁の文字列か確認します(000、空欄、4桁以上は使えません)。Check that it is a three-digit string from 001 to 999 (000, an empty value and four or more digits are not allowed).
Notebook 02〜04 が、実行前の確認で停止するNotebooks 02–04 stop at the checks before runningENVIRONMENT(dev・test・prod)、SCOPE_FILE、PRIVATE_EVIDENCE_DIR(実行記録の保存先)、EXPECTED_WORKSPACE_NAME(正確な表示名)が設定されているかを確認します。Notebook が、範囲のファイルに書かれたフォルダーにあるかも確認します。書き込みを伴う段階では、APPLY_CHANGES、CONFIRMED_PLAN_SHA256、WRITE_GATE_FILE(承認のファイル)も必要です。Check that ENVIRONMENT (dev, test or prod), SCOPE_FILE, PRIVATE_EVIDENCE_DIR (the run-record folder) and EXPECTED_WORKSPACE_NAME (the exact display name) are set. Also check that the Notebook is in the folder named in the scope file. Stages that write also need APPLY_CHANGES, CONFIRMED_PLAN_SHA256 and WRITE_GATE_FILE (the approval file).
Notebook 05 の適用が、ハッシュの不一致で止まるThe Notebook 05 apply run stops on a hash mismatchプレビューをやり直し、新しい PLAN_SHA256 をコピーします。プレビューと適用で PARTICIPANT_ID、INCREMENT_PATH、ALLOW_AUTOMATED_APPLY(True の場合は EXPECTED_WORKSPACE_NAME も)の値が違うと、ハッシュも変わります。Run the preview again and copy the new PLAN_SHA256. If PARTICIPANT_ID, INCREMENT_PATH or ALLOW_AUTOMATED_APPLY (and, when it is True, EXPECTED_WORKSPACE_NAME) differ between the preview and the apply run, the hash changes.
SQL analytics endpoint でテーブルが見えない、または件数が古いTables are missing or counts look old in the SQL analytics endpoint同期を待ってから再確認します。Notebook 01 を再実行しません。Wait for synchronization and check again. Do not rerun Notebook 01.
Instances に行が表示されないInstances shows no rowsバインド先のテーブル・列・キーと、SQL analytics endpoint の同期を確認します。Check the bound table, columns and key, and the SQL analytics endpoint synchronization.
Activator の activation が記録されないNo Activator activation is recordedルールが停止している間に Edit action → Apply → Save を行ったか、ルールを Start したか、ファイルが Files/increment にあり、Live feed に FileCreated が届いているかを確認します。再アップロードせず、ルールを Stop して講師に伝えます。Check that you did Edit action → Apply → Save while the rule was stopped, that you started the rule, that the file is in Files/increment and that FileCreated arrived in Live feed. Do not re-upload; stop the rule and tell the instructor.
KQL の行数が想定の2倍になるKQL row counts are twice the expected value同じファイルを2回取り込んでいます(再アップロード、または自動と手動の両方)。それ以上の取り込みを止めて講師に伝えます。データを消すには講師の承認が必要です。The same file was ingested twice (re-uploaded, or both automatic and manual). Stop further ingestion and tell the instructor. Deleting data requires the instructor's approval.
時系列の観測が0件になるThe time series shows zero observations所有範囲・schema・RLS、DonationEvents の mirroring policy の安全な読み取り、実際の Delta add と parquet、KQL との件数・金額・キー・UTC 時刻・重複の照合を確認します。その後、DonatedAt、MunicipalityID → MunicipalityId、DonationEvents テーブル(ビューではない)の native バインドと実行クエリを確認します。Delta が無い、不一致、Backfill=true の HTTP 400、RLS や policy が互換でない場合は停止し、再試行・reset・off/on・再取り込みやセキュリティ無効化をしません。CompletionPercentage=100% や定義の読み取りだけでは、native 時系列・Metrics の照会成功にはなりません。Check ownership scope, schema and RLS, safe DonationEvents mirroring policy readback, actual Delta add/parquet, and reconciliation with KQL for counts, amounts, keys, UTC timestamps and duplicates. Then verify the native binding to DonatedAt, MunicipalityID → MunicipalityId and the DonationEvents table (not the view), plus the executed query. Stop for missing Delta, mismatches, Backfill=true HTTP 400, or incompatible RLS/policy; do not retry, reset, toggle off/on, replay or disable security. CompletionPercentage=100% or definition readback alone is not successful native time-series or Metrics query execution.
Notebook 02 が停止するNotebook 02 stops24章の自動配置で作成した Ontology か、handoff-ontology の実行前か、Metrics を追加していないかを確認します。適用が「Explicit expected-definition SHA differs」で止まった場合は、プレビューをやり直し、出力の beforeDefinitionSha256 を EXPECTED_DEFINITION_SHA256 に設定します。Check that the ontology was created by the automated deployment in Chapter 24, that handoff-ontology has not run yet and that no Metrics were added. If the apply run stops with "Explicit expected-definition SHA differs", run the preview again and set EXPECTED_DEFINITION_SHA256 to the beforeDefinitionSha256 value in its output.
Metrics が表示されないMetrics are not shown主 Ontology で Metrics が設定済みか、メジャーを持つテーブルと Read・Build 権限を確認します。未設定の場合は未設定として記録します。2件目を作成せず、直接 Semantic model の DAX を別に確認します。Check whether Metrics are configured on the main ontology, the measure-owning table, and Read and Build permissions. Record unconfigured state as such, retain one ontology, and check direct semantic-model DAX separately.
Graph で Ineligible と表示されるGraph shows Ineligibleツールチップの理由を読みます。キー、バインド、ソースの種類(Semantic model から作った Entity は対象外)、バインド先のテーブルの数を確認します。Read the reason in the tooltip. Check the key, the bindings, the source type (entities generated from a semantic model are not eligible) and the number of bound tables.
Eligible なのに Materialize が失敗するMaterialize fails although items are Eligible時系列 Property などの型の対応を確認し、エラーを記録してその機能を停止します。主 Ontology や時系列は変更せず、別の Ontology も作りません。Check time-series and other type support, record the error and stop that feature. Keep the main ontology and time series unchanged without creating another ontology.
Rule を登録しても通知されないA registered rule sends no alerts仕様どおりです。Rules は AI が説明に使う文脈で、通知や処理は行いません。ファイルの到着による処理は Activator(9章)で行います。This is expected. Rules are context for AI explanations and do not send alerts or run actions. Processing on file arrival is done by the Activator (Chapter 9).
添付ファイルの内容が回答に使われないAttached file content is not used in answers同じ会話で添付したか、ファイル名を挙げて依頼したか、1会話10ファイル・1ファイル 5 MB 以内かを確認します。ページを更新すると、添付は使えなくなります。Check that you attached the files in the same conversation, referred to them by name, and stayed within 10 files per conversation and 5 MB per file. Refreshing the page makes attachments unavailable.
RDF に注釈・同義語・バインドが無いRDF lacks annotations, synonyms or bindings配布の TTL は構造の参照資料です。主 Ontology のバインドや native 機能は、その定義と実際の照会で別に確認します。The distributed TTL is a structural reference. Verify main-ontology bindings and native capabilities separately through their definitions and actual queries.
Data Agent に Ontology を追加できない(No data added のまま)An ontology cannot be added to the Data Agent (it stays at No data added)新しいエクスペリエンスの Ontology に関する既知の問題の可能性があります。設定を変えず、講師に伝えます。This may be a known issue with ontologies in the new experience. Do not change settings; tell the instructor.
T10 に「There's content here I can't work with」と表示されるT10 shows "There's content here I can't work with"プラットフォームの安全フィルターです。ブロックとして記録し、言い換えなどで回避しません。This is the platform's safety filter. Record it as blocked and do not try to get around it by rephrasing.
グラフの日本語が □ になるJapanese text in a chart appears as boxes日本語フォントを使って、同じデータからグラフを作り直すよう依頼します。Ask for the chart to be created again from the same data with a Japanese font.
Version history に、保存した版が表示されない(No versions yet のまま)A saved version does not appear in Version history (it still shows No versions yet)保存を繰り返さず、Restore の演習を省略して講師に伝えます。Do not repeat the save; skip the Restore exercise and tell the instructor.
Data Agent の SQL の例が Invalid と表示されるSQL examples in the Data Agent show Invalid実際の質問で SQL が実行できるかを確認します。表示を変えるために例を書き換えず、講師に伝えます。Check whether SQL runs for actual questions. Do not rewrite the examples to change the status; tell the instructor.
クリーンアップで Eventhouse を削除できないThe Eventhouse cannot be deleted during cleanup繰り返し削除せず、講師に伝えます。削除済みの別のアイテムが参照している場合があります。Do not keep retrying; tell the instructor. Another deleted item may still refer to it.
